notes: The Business Standard (Bangladesh), www.tbsnews.net, Drupal site. Tried, in order: (1) /robots.txt 200, permissive (only /search/, /admin/, /includes/, /user/... disallowed; Crawl-delay: 10) - it advertises /sitemap.xml, /bangla/sitemap.xml, /googlenews.xml, /bangla/googlenews.xml. (2) /sitemap.xml 404 and tbsnews.net/sitemap.xml 404: there are NO per-day or per-month sitemaps at all, so the sitemap index route is closed. (3) /googlenews.xml 200, a Google News urlset with <news:publication_date> on every item, but it only holds ~2 days (window ends 2026-10-25, crawl date 2026-10-27), so it covers nothing of the window. (4) /archive 200, a 'Search news by date' page whose datepicker always renders TODAY regardless of the parameter: /archive/2026-10-10, /archive?date=2026-10-10, /archive/20261010 all return 200 with today's date label and today's news (silent trap, no redirect, no 404). (5) The datepicker handler is /sites/all/modules/custom/rsi_news/widgets/archive/archive.js (200): document.location = '/archive/' + dateText.replace(/-/g,'/') - i.e. the real route is /archive/YYYY/MM/DD, slash-separated. That works: /archive/2026/10/10 200 with heading '10 October, 2026', 'News (165)', 148 article links on one page; /archive/2026/10/20 200 with '20 October, 2026', 176 declared, 155 links. ROUTE USED: one request per day of 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 to /archive/YYYY/MM/DD (31 requests, 10 s apart to honour the site's Crawl-delay: 10, ~5.5 min total), article links matched by /<section>/.../-<nodeid> and filtered to drop /videos/, /cartoons/, /multimedia/, /photo/, /gallery/, /live/ (short pages), absolute-ised on www.tbsnews.net, deduped keeping the first day seen. Listed date = the day the archive page states in its own <div class="archive-date"> heading, and the script rejects any day whose heading does not match the requested date. Result: 4507 unique URLs, 31/31 days, 09-30=177, 10-10=127, 10-20=137, minimum 93 (2026-10-23) - real high volume, so low_volume is not claimed. DATE VERIFIED: 6 article pages re-fetched (2 per check day), all HTTP 200, 3517-8207 characters of text, and page JSON-LD datePublished exactly equal to the listed date with time +06:00 (e.g. 2026-09-30T16:50:00+06:00 for a 2026-09-30 row); the +06:00 Dhaka offset means an article can never slip a calendar day. Key gotcha for the next worker: /archive without the slash-separated YYYY/MM/DD silently serves today's news with today's date label instead of erroring, and the site has no sitemap index at all despite advertising one.
